target.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes
target.body:
Closes #107707

## What Problem This Solves

`applySkillProposal` in the Skill Workshop wrote stripped proposal content directly to SKILL.md with no body validation. Plan or change-description proposals could silently overwrite real skill content, and the default `approvalPolicy` change to `auto` (PR #107690) removed the human review gate that previously caught these cases. This is the canonical apply-boundary fix for #107707; the merged generation-side hardening (PR #108339) explicitly left apply-side validation unresolved.

## Why This Change Was Made

PR #108339 hardened generation prompts so LLMs produce full-content proposals (issue #107708), but explicitly left apply-side validation for #107707. Without apply-side checks, any plan-only or unrelated proposal body that passes the scanner (which only checks secrets/injection, not content structure) can overwrite SKILL.md Ticket: [Bug: Skill Workshop Apply overwrites SKILL.md with proposal text verbatim (data loss)](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/107707).

Codex review identified two P1 issues in the initial patch:
1. **Write-before-guard**: `applySkillProposal` computed `requiresExplicitApproval` but called `writeWorkspaceSkill` before returning the flag, so any shared-service caller (CLI, Gateway) could overwrite content without presenting an approval grant.
2. **Missing metadata validation**: `parseFrontmatter` only checked parse success; `name` and `description` fields were not verified before overwriting SKILL.md.

## User Impact

- Empty proposal bodies are hard-rejected with a descriptive error; SKILL.md remains unchanged
- Proposals without valid SKILL.md frontmatter (missing `name` or `description`) are hard-rejected before any write
- Low-continuity update proposals are **blocked at the shared service boundary** — SKILL.md is never written unless the caller presents an explicit approval grant (`explicitApprovalGranted=true` via `--approve` flag, Gateway approval dialog, or agent tool after policy hook approval)
- Substantially continuous updates (≥3 shared non-heading lines, ≥50% original content retained) apply normally without requiring explicit approval
- CLI `skills workshop apply` gains `--approve` flag (default false) for manual low-continuity override
- Rollback data (`previousContent`) is recorded in `rollback.json` for all successful applies
- Bounded change summary (`+N lines, -M lines`) shown in approval descriptions and apply results

**Maintainer decision needed**: The low-continuity approval override changes the recently established automatic approval policy (PR #107690). This conditional exception requires explicit maintainer confirmation from shakkernerd (who introduced the automatic approval behavior). Options: (1) Keep the safety exception — require explicit approval only for low-continuity updates while substantially continuous updates continue using automatic approval (recommended). (2) Preserve unconditional automatic approval — reject structurally invalid proposals but allow all structurally valid updates to retain automatic approval. (3) Require approval for every update — simpler safety rule but more workflow regression.

## Evidence

**Real environment**: Linux, Node v24.13.1, **exact head SHA `d978145d757d`**

### P1 #1: Block low-continuity writes in the apply service

Codex review finding: `validateApplyBody only records requiresExplicitApproval; applySkillProposal then writes the replacement and returns the flag afterward. Make the service stop before writeWorkspaceSkill unless the caller supplies authoritative explicit approval for a low-continuity replacement.` (confidence 0.99 → resolved ✅)

Fix at `src/skills/workshop/service.ts:601-605`:

```typescript
if (bodyValidation.requiresExplicitApproval && !input.explicitApprovalGranted) {
  throw new Error("Update requires explicit approval...");
}
await writeWorkspaceSkill({ ... });
```

Callers: agent tool + Gateway pass `explicitApprovalGranted: true`, CLI defaults to `explicitApprovalGranted: false` (requires `--approve`).

### P1 #2: Validate required SKILL.md frontmatter fields

Codex review finding: `parseFrontmatter(skillContent) proves only that the frontmatter can be parsed; this code never checks that name and description are present and non-empty before overwriting the target.` (confidence 0.97)

Fix at `src/skills/workshop/service.ts:664-675`:

```typescript
const name = parsed["name"];
const description = parsed["description"];
if (!name || name.trim().length === 0) { throw new Error("...name..."); }
if (!description || description.trim().length === 0) { throw new Error("...description..."); }
```

### Live real behavior proof (exact head SHA `d978145d757d`)

All 12 scenarios pass on the current head:

```console
=== Comprehensive Real Behavior Proof ===
SHA: d978145d757d
Timestamp: 2026-07-17T13:57:43.484Z
Node: v24.13.1

=== SECTION 1: Service Boundary Guard ===
1a CLI no --approve: Update requires explicit approval; proposal has
  insufficient content continuity with the current skill.
1a SKILL.md unchanged: true
1b CLI with --approve: written=true, contains "New A.": true

=== SECTION 2: Approval Hook ===
2a low-continuity: requireApproval (BLOCKED), file unchanged: true
2b high-continuity: undefined (ALLOWED)

=== SECTION 3: Incidental Overlap ===
3a heading-only: BLOCKED
3b 1-line overlap: BLOCKED
3c 2-line overlap: BLOCKED
3d substantial (4/6, 67%): requiresExplicitApproval=false

=== SECTION 4: Frontmatter Validation ===
4a missing name: guard blocks
4b missing description: guard blocks
4c empty body: "Proposal body is empty after stripping proposal-only frontmatter"

=== SECTION 5: Change Summary ===
changeSummary: +3 lines, -3 lines

=== Summary ===
1. Service guard blocks write before writeWorkspaceSkill
2. Approval hook blocks low-continuity, allows high-continuity
3. Incidental heading-only/1-line/2-line overlap: all BLOCKED
4. Substantial continuity (4/6, 67%): allowed
5. Missing name/description: hard rejection before write
6. Empty body: hard rejection
7. Change summary recorded
```

Note for Section 4a/4b: `proposeUpdateSkill` always generates proposal frontmatter with `name` and `description`, so the name/description check in `validateApplyBody` is a defense-in-depth guard. The protection path is: service boundary guard → (on explicit approval) → validateApplyBody re-checks frontmatter fields → write.

### Unit tests (exact head SHA `d978145d757d`)

```console
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
    src/skills/workshop/apply-body-validation.test.ts \
    src/skills/workshop/policy.test.ts \
    src/skills/workshop/service.test.ts \
    --run

 ✓ apply-body-validation.test.ts (4 tests)
 ✓ policy.test.ts (9 tests)
 ✓ service.test.ts (35 tests)

 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  48 passed (48)
```

### Code review findings status

| Finding | File | Status |
|---------|------|--------|
| [P1] Block low-continuity writes in the apply service | `service.ts:601-605` | ✅ Guard before `writeWorkspaceSkill` |
| [P1] Validate required SKILL.md frontmatter fields | `service.ts:664-675` | ✅ `name`, `description` non-empty |
| [P2] Remove machine-local iCodeMate configuration | `.icodemate/skills.json` | ✅ Already removed from branch |
| [P1] Maintainer decision: approval-policy owner confirmation | — | ⏳ Requires shakkernerd |

**Pre-existing CI issues**: `startup-memory` RSS 425 MB limit and `test/install-sh-docker.test.ts` format — both from `main`, not this PR.
